sermon.title: Grace, Faith, and Christ Alone—January 9, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus never said we are saved by grace alone, faith alone or Christ alone—the Reformers did. Believers are not condemned, but those who love darkness are; he who does the truth comes to the light, and all are judged by works. Salvation is a bundle with Jesus as the essential ingredient.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 24:07 after worship.

faqs.question: Did Jesus say we are saved by grace alone?
Who said grace alone and faith alone?
What else did the Reformers accept?
faqs.answer: Slavery and the treatment of Indians.

faqs.question: What does John 3:16 promise?
faqs.answer: Believers shall not perish but have eternal life.

faqs.question: Why should the church be urgent?
faqs.answer: Those who reject Jesus are condemned.

faqs.question: What do those who receive Jesus get?
faqs.answer: Power to become sons of God.

faqs.question: What can’t be left out of salvation?
faqs.answer: Jesus Christ in His birth, death and resurrection.
